recipe.title: Chocolate chunk oat cookies
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Jo Seagar's website.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 170 deg C. Line two oven trays with baking paper.

method.s: Beat butter, condensed milk and sugar together until light and very pale and creamy.
Add flour, rolled oats, baking powder and chocolate chunks and mix well.
Flatten spoonfuls of the mixture onto the prepared trays. Use a wet fork to press the mixture down.
Cook for 18 – 20 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on a wire rack and store in an airtight container.
